description: 新北市垃圾清運車輛所在位置 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府環境保護局. 一、新北市垃圾清運車輛所在位址。 二、資料僅顯示目前出勤中之垃圾車所在位址，故不同時段，資料數會有明顯不同（每2分鐘更新1次），甚至少數時段可能為零。 三、垃圾車車機採4G訊號傳輸，倘有訊號不良情形，可能導致資料延遲。. Coverage: 新北市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
